Convert percentiles to hexadecimal colors

Source: R/calc_ejscreen_export.R
pctile2colorhex.Rd

Convert percentiles to hexadecimal colors

Usage

pctile2colorhex(
  x,
  colorbins = c(0, ejscreen_color_defaults()$colorbins, 100),
  colorfills = ejscreen_color_defaults()$colorfills,
  na.color = NA
)

Arguments

x

Numeric vector of percentiles on a 0-100 scale.

colorbins

Strictly increasing bin boundaries INCLUDING endpoints (normally 0 and 100), unlike pctile2color()'s interior cutoffs.

colorfills

Color palette passed to leaflet::colorBin(). Defaults to gray, yellow, orange, and red; other palette lengths are interpolated.

na.color

Color for missing or out-of-range values, default NA.

Value

Character vector of hexadecimal colors, as long as x. Out-of-range values also produce a warning from Leaflet.

Details

Cutoffs belong to the higher bin; the final endpoint is included. The default scheme has four bins. With explicit boundaries, values are checked against their range rather than an additional 0-100 restriction.

See also

pctile2color() ejscreen_color_defaults()

Examples

EJAM:::pctile2colorhex(c(79, 80, 90, 95, 100, NA))
# #BEBEBE, #FFFF00, #FFA500, #FF0000, #FF0000, NA
defaults <- EJAM:::ejscreen_color_defaults()
EJAM:::pctile2colorhex(c(79, 80, 95, NA),
  colorbins = c(0, defaults$colorbins, 100),
  colorfills = defaults$colorfills, na.color = "#808080")
